Question: Is \(x^2-1=(x+1)(x-1)\) a factorization?

Choices.A: No, because this is polynomial multiplication.
Choices.B: No, because the two sides of the equation are not equal.
Choices.C: Yes, because the polynomial has been rewritten as a product of polynomial expressions.
Choices.D: No, because the right-hand side has not been rewritten as a single polynomial.

Solution: Factorization means rewriting a polynomial as a product of polynomial expressions. The right-hand side is precisely in the form of a product of polynomial expressions.
